@everyone

I wanted to make a quick announcement clarifying the new prompting from the Engage APP -
It states you must visit their website and connect your twitter as seen below   

This is legitimate and needed if you want to continue using the Engage system.

I reached out directly to Engage.io inquiring specifically on this change. 

Their response:

"We have upgraded to V2 version of twitter API, all users need to connect the twitter via the prompting"

Thank you for your attention on this matter.
